matches.quote: The 0.7 eV peak is assigned to Pr 5d hybridized states and then "disregarded" without independent evidence
Five parameters (J1–J4, J⊥) are fitted to a single dispersion ... The authors should report the fit covariance or correlation matrix ... test whether a reduced model ... fits
no evidence of order is shown ... replace "3D antiferromagnetic order" with "three-dimensional (interlayer) spin correlations".
The PrNiO2 d_z² energy, 2.96 ± 0.58 eV (Table I), is essentially unconstrained, so the statement that it is "possibly larger" ... should be removed
quantified, for example by crossed/total ratios per peak in data versus calculation... the d_xy intensity mismatch at H = 0.4 (σ) is attributed to Pr 5d ... without a test
Alternatives to a J⊥ dispersion are not ruled out: ... an artefact of the elastic/phonon subtraction ... show the Γ-point spectra, their decomposition
Fig. 2(a) shows a sum of spectra over H = 0.4–0.475, across which the magnon disperses, which broadens it.
The magnon damping comparison does not isolate self-doping, so it does not support "self-doping has a much milder impact on spin order than chemical doping".
The two films sit on different substrates, and the effect of strain on J1, the orbiton hopping and the d_xy energy is not addressed.
The suggestion of stripe or incommensurate order from the (0.2,0.2) dispersion maximum and the extra elastic intensity beyond (0.25,0.25) (p. 5) is unsupported.
Near Γ the magnon lies close to the phonon ... and the Γ-point error bars in Fig. 3(a) are the largest ... show the Γ-point spectra, their decomposition
state which fit parameters (widths, positions and amplitudes of neighbouring peaks ... the continuum shape) were free, fixed or shared across Q
The crystal-field (10Dq/Ds/Dt or orbital energies), spin–orbit, exchange-field, core-hole lifetime and broadening parameters behind Fig. 4(g–l) are not given... add a parameter table
The statement ... give "a proof of the fully occurred topotactic reduction … and the absence of interstitial oxygen atoms" does not follow
Δ = 8.00 eV ... reads as tuning ... U = 3.2 eV ... give effective one-band U values, not the on-site multiplet Hubbard U a multiband charge-transfer model requires.

notes: P25 is marked incorrect because the Fig. 5(b) caption already defines the vertical lines as fixed at the minimum of the dispersion of the dxy and dxz/yz peaks. C2 and C3 are marked partly because the review challenges the unproven absence of interstitial/excess oxygen (P19, P24) and the Pr 5d assignment of the 0.7 eV peak (P19, P22) without specifically attributing the 0.7 eV feature to an impurity diffraction phase or asking to drop the term 'chemically undoped'.
